# Methods in Health Data Science with R

This page groups the full training pathway, course calendar, pre-registration, payment links, and participant instructions in one place.

The pathway is designed for clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and data analysts who want to use R for health data analysis.

All courses are delivered online on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, from 17:00 to 19:00 Morocco time. Each cohort is limited to 20 participants.

## Course Pathway

| Course | Focus | Price | Seats |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Applied Biostatistics with R | Foundations of statistical analysis for clinical and biomedical research | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Machine Learning with R | Practical machine learning workflows for health data science using R | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R | Kaplan-Meier curves, Cox models, prediction, and interpretation | 1500 DH | 20 |
| Meta-Analysis with R | Effect sizes, heterogeneity, forest plots, and reproducible evidence synthesis | 1500 DH | 20 |

## Course Details

### Applied Biostatistics with R

Participants learn to import, clean, summarize, analyze, and report health datasets in R. The course covers statistical tests, regression models, reproducible tables, figures, and manuscript-ready outputs.

### Machine Learning with R

Participants learn practical supervised learning workflows for health data, including data preparation, model training, validation, performance evaluation, and interpretation.

### Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R

Participants learn to structure time-to-event data, estimate Kaplan-Meier curves, fit Cox models, check assumptions, and communicate survival results for clinical research.

### Meta-Analysis with R

Participants learn to prepare extracted study data, compute effect sizes, assess heterogeneity, choose models, create forest plots, and document reproducible meta-analysis workflows.

## After Payment

After payment, participants should receive a confirmation email with the course name, payment confirmation, next steps, communication channel invitation, course start date, and support contact.

If payment and pre-registration use different email addresses, please mention this in the pre-registration form or contact by email.

## Automation Structure

The operational workflow is:

```text
Quarto website
↓
Google Form pre-registration
↓
Google Sheets participant database
↓
PayPal payment
↓
Payment confirmation
↓
Google Sheets update
↓
Gmail/gmailr confirmation email
↓
Discord/Telegram invitation
```

The recommended Google Sheets schema and R automation placeholders are documented in [Registration Automation](automation.qmd).
